mission: Determine whether RockAndEgg-313M-v2 beats matched BERT/DeBERTa baselines and in which regimes.

subject.architecture: Qwen3Model, 10 layers, hidden 1024, ~312.9M params (~156M embedding, ~157M compute)

A.name: Pareto
A.statement: at equal or better measured throughput, RAE-v2 matches or beats deberta-v3-base+recipe on clean-transfer fine-tuning
A.pass_criterion: Throughput ratio >= 1.0 (fp16, 128, bs 64) AND CI lower bound of macro delta > 0 AND wins on >= 6 of 10 tasks

B.name: Data efficiency
B.statement: at 1% and 10% of capped training data, RAE-v2 beats bert-base+recipe and deberta-v3-base+recipe
B.pass_criterion: Same statistical criterion as A, separately at each budget (1% and 10%)

C.name: Multilingual and robustness
C.statement: after fine-tuning on 50k English MNLI, RAE-v2 beats xlm-roberta-base and mdeberta-v3-base on XNLI (non-English macro-average), and is within error of or above deberta-v3-base on HANS and ANLI
C.pass_criterion: CI lower bound of XNLI non-English delta > 0

D.name: Parity at lower cost
D.pass_criterion: Throughput ratio >= 1.5 AND CI lower bound of clean-transfer macro delta > -1.0 point

E.name: Frozen quality
E.pass_criterion: CI lower bound > 0 under both linear and MLP probes

controls: effect of the recipe on baselines
effect of the recipe on RAE (RAE-v2 vs truncated-Qwen3-raw)
macro_average_rule: clean-transfer and trained-on diagnostics reported separately; never blended
